version.author: Free Mix Audio
version.changelog: v1.4 (2026-10-04) - NEW: Vintage Drive saturator — warm tube-style even-harmonic saturation ("silk" voicing: asymmetric triode-like curve, ultra-soft knee, subtlety-first). Red DRIVE knob (0% = transparent) plus FOCUS selector (Sub / Full / Air) so the user chooses which band gets saturated. 2x oversampled saturation path for alias-free harmonics. Drive power switch (ON = processing). v1.3 (2026-10-01) - GUI controls now update the DSP in real time (no need to press play) - Per-section bypass switches respond instantly v1.2 - Initial FMA Series release
